description: This file defines the LogCategory enum, which categorizes connection-related logs within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides known categories such as SOURCE, TARGET, RESPONSE, and CONNECTION, and includes utility methods for retrieving categories by name.

classes.name: LogCategory
classes.description: An enum representing various categories of connection logs, each associated with a string label and utility methods for conversion and representation.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the string label used in JSON representation for this log category.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Retrieves the LogCategory enum constant matching the provided name, or an empty Optional if no match is found.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string label of this log category.
